edits.content:
## Final code audit
Before returning code, compare the executable calls against the full-conversation coverage checklist. Confirm that every still-pending request and new constraint has the appropriate schema-supported search or refinement call, that refinements use the latest compatible cached result, and that no unaffected, already-satisfied domain is reprocessed. For every result-producing call, verify its exact return value is assigned and saved under a unique key. A cache read alone does not fulfill a newly requested action, and `print("No planning needed")` is valid only when the checklist contains no unmet action or constraint.
